blurb: Guests take a scenic flight to 10,000 ft above ground, then exit the plane attached to an instructor for a tandem skydive. Freefall lasts approximately until 5,000 ft, where the parachute opens for a slow descent. The experience includes views of Mt. Currie, Pemberton, and Whistler.
extraNote: Weather evaluation on day of jump; few clouds and light winds ideal · No alcohol or drugs allowed; will not be allowed to board if present · Pemberton Airport

quotes.author: Georgia
quotes.text: What an experience!! I had an amazing tandem jump with Sally, I was not nervous whatsoever and she made it extremely enjoyable! Steve the owner is super friendly, and runs a great business! I love the doggies there to pet while you wait to jump as well. The videos and pictures are definitely worth the extra $ too! Would definitely come back again!!

quotes.author: Local
quotes.text: Thank you Steve! You are awesome dude!! 100% recommend this company, my first skydive and what better way with excellent, professional and rad instructors with those beautiful peaks! Steve is a pro and a great tandem to help you along the way. The scenery is absolutely mega. Don’t hesitate, get booked now otherwise you're missing out.

quotes.author: Danielle
quotes.text: The best experience ever!! Our instructor Jake was amazing and made me feel so comfortable before and during the skydive. Views were unreal. Highly recommend everyone to check a skydive off their bucket lists.

quotes.author: Rinkal
quotes.text: Best location for skydiving. Beautiful scenery and instructor Steve made it more fun and beautiful. I would recommend Steve as a instructor.
